src.core.statistics.amount_trains¶

This module computes from given departure and arrival stations, the ratio of delayed at departure and arrival, and cancelled trains. The ratio is computed from the amount of delayed/cancelled trains over the total planned trains on a given period.

Functions¶

get_ratio_cancelled_trains(→ float)

Calculate the ratio of cancelled trains

get_total_planned_trains(→ int)

Returns the amount of planned trains over a period,

get_ratio_delayed_departure_trains(→ float)

Calculate the ratio of delayed trains at departure

get_ratio_delayed_arrival_trains(→ float)

Calculate the ratio of delayed trains at arrival

Module Contents¶

src.core.statistics.amount_trains.get_ratio_cancelled_trains(departure_station: str, arrival_station: str, start_month: int, end_month: int, years_list: numpy.array, data_df: pandas.DataFrame | None = None) → float¶

Calculate the ratio of cancelled trains to the total number of planned trains over a period, given a departure and arrival stations.

The ratio is calculated using only valid monthly observations.

Parameters:

  • departure_station (str) – departure station

  • arrival_station (str) – arrival station

  • start_month (int) – start month of period

  • end_month (int) – end month of period

  • years_list (np.array) – selected years list

  • data_df (pd.DataFrame) – input dataframe with MONTH, YEAR, DEPARTURE_STATION_KEY

  • columns (and ARRIVAL_STATION_KEY)

Returns:

the ratio of cancelled trains

to the total number of planned trains over a period between two given stations, or NaN if no valid observations are available

Return type:

cancelled_trains_ratio (float)
